text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 铁锈红色缎面平领抹胸修身长礼服，横褶腰胯、侧高开衩、及地小拖尾，黑色尖头高跟鞋。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 59 position single. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. For images 27 and 28 there are 3 rows x 8 persons: each row joins two 4-person panels. For image 21 left/middle-left/middle-right/right are its four distinct clothing sets. For image 31 the left side has six dresses in two rows; right side has three people. For image 29 c1-c5 means its five main columns. For image 36 c4 bottom means the red lace dress in fourth column below a cropped advertisement; ignore cropped neighboring items. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. GARMENTS AND SHOWN FOOTWEAR ONLY: 铁锈红色缎面平领抹胸修身长礼服，横褶腰胯、侧高开衩、及地小拖尾，黑色尖头高跟鞋. Remove ALL detachable accessories including 铁锈红色窄颈巾；黑色小手提包. Keep integral garment fasteners, sewn bows and ties. No new items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
